title: Numbering restarts odt 001
notes: real ODF list numbering: text:list-style "L1" in styles.xml (level 1 text:list-level-style-number, text:num-format="1", text:start-value="1"), two text:list of 5 text:list-items each referencing it; the second list carries text:continue-numbering="false" so its counter restarts at 1. ODF restart semantics stated honestly: text:continue-numbering DEFAULTS to false, so a sibling text:list sharing a list-style does not continue the previous counter anyway — the explicit text:continue-numbering="false" pins the restart (continuation would require "true"); text:start-value on the level style sets the per-level start. Reference text is the exact item strings only — the number markers are render-derived, never in the file as text. No normative counter matches list elements, so feature counts stay 0.
